title_en: 2026 Integrity Special Lecture for Enrolled Students (Online, Zoom)
summary: Enrolled undergraduate and graduate students may attend an online special lecture on anti-corruption law, held as part of the 2026 1st SNU Integrity Week. The lecture takes place on Thursday, 17 September 2026, from 14:00 to 16:00 as a live Zoom session accessed through the Integrity Week website (https://cleanweek.snu.ac.kr). Students who attend at least 80% of the session will receive a small commemorative gift (mobile gift voucher).
applies_to: Enrolled students (undergraduate and graduate). The notice does not state that attendance is mandatory.

dates.what: Anti-corruption law special lecture (live online session via Zoom)

conditions: The lecture is held online only, as a live Zoom video session.
To complete the lecture, you must attend at least 80% of the session time.
Only students who complete the lecture will receive the commemorative gift (mobile gift voucher).
steps: Go to the Integrity Week website (https://cleanweek.snu.ac.kr) before 14:00 on 17 September 2026.
On the website, select Five-Day Schedule [5일간의 일정] > Integrity Talk [청렴 토크] > For Enrolled Students – Anti-Corruption Law Special Lecture [재학생 대상 - 반부패 법령 특강] > Join Zoom [zoom 접속하기].
Attend the live Zoom lecture and remain for at least 80% of the two-hour session to meet the completion requirement.
translation:
Title: Notice on the 2026 Integrity Special Lecture for Enrolled Students

As part of the 2026 1st SNU Integrity Week [「2026년 제1회 SNU 청렴주간」], a special lecture on anti-corruption and integrity will be held as follows, to foster integrity awareness among enrolled students and to build a sound campus culture.

A. Target: Enrolled students (undergraduate and graduate)

B. Content: Special lecture on anti-corruption law / [Online] live video session (ZOOM)

C. Date and time: Thursday, 17 September 2026, 14:00 to 16:00 (2 hours)

D. How to join:
① Go to the Integrity Week website (https://cleanweek.snu.ac.kr).
② Select Five-Day Schedule [5일간의 일정] > Integrity Talk [청렴 토크] > For Enrolled Students – Anti-Corruption Law Special Lecture [재학생 대상 - 반부패 법령 특강] > Join Zoom [zoom 접속하기].

E. Completion requirement: Attendance of at least 80% of the session time.

F. Note: Students who complete the lecture are scheduled to receive a small commemorative gift (mobile gift voucher [모바일 기프티콘]). End.
